mediaDecoding.limitation: Decoding proves usable media bytes, not visual correctness or complete source-ref selection. No historical tests were rerun.

recordReadback.limitation: Full records compare original identity, complete source, outcome and dates after Harness integrity validation. Regression points compare their entire projected fields and capture provenance, excluding derived media addresses/gaps. Historical tests are not rerun; unselected refs and newer commits remain outside scope.
